'''Elber''' is one of the [[Queen's Guards]] in the employ of Lord [[Gaebril]].

== Appearance ==
He is pudgy with beady eyes.

== Activities ==
He chases away [[Matrim Cauthon]] when Mat tries to pass on [[Elayne Trakand]]'s letter to [[Morgase Trakand]].{{ref/book|3|45}} Mat sneaks in anyway and as [[Martyn Tallanvor]] escorts Mat out of the Royal Palace, Tallanvor scolds Elber for not allowing Mat into the Palace in the first place.{{ref/book|3|47}}
